Independent reviews also found that the REACH VET program identified at-risk veterans and was associated with increased outpatient appointment completion, although mortality effects remained unproven (E035). A named Allo Ecole channel accepted complaints about teacher non-payment and abuse and provided investigation and confidentiality procedures, offering evidence of an accountability mechanism (E045). However, UNICEF reported that approximately 3.2 million primary-age children remained out of school, while another account placed the broader 5–17 out-of-school population near seven million (E016, E017). More than 2,000 schools closed and over 800,000 children were displaced during the conflict period (E044), and the World Bank described reforms as unfinished because of insecurity, administrative complexity, and limited assistance (E054). These adverse conditions are serious but cannot be assigned solely to the president, given provincial, donor, conflict, and inherited state-capacity roles. Germany also admitted and supported large numbers of Ukrainian refugees, but a representative 2022 survey found that only 17% of working-age respondents were employed and identified major needs in language, employment, health care, and housing (E025).
